LAW AND MOTION THE COURT ADOPTED ITS TENTATIVE RULING AS FOLLOWS: DEFENDANTS CALIFORNIA RECOVEYANCE COMPANY AND J P MORGAN CHASE BANK, N.A'S DEMURRER TO COMPLAINT IS SUSTAINED WITH 10 DAYS LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO CAUSES OF ACTION 7 AND 8 FOR PLAINTIFF TO PLEAD CLAIMS AGAINST THIS DEFENDANT BASED ON ITS CONDUCT SUBSEQUENT TO ACQUISITION OF WAMU ASSETS, IF PLAINTIFF CAN DO SO IN GOOD FAITH. SUSTAINED WITHOUT LEAVE TO AMEND AS TO ALL OTHER CAUSES OF ACTION BECAUSE J P MORGAN DID NOT TAKE ON WAMU'S LIABILITIES. DEFENDANT'S COUNSEL IS DIRECTED TO READ AND COMPLY WITH LOCAL RULE 2.6 (C) AND C R C 3.1113 (D) AND (E). PREVAILING PARTY IS TO SUBMIT A PROPOSED FORM OF ORDER. JUDGE: PETER J.
